attBesluta.text: Ordered the 18" model. Sturdy and effective. No problems cutting the entire length of the blade. No complaints, except for the mildly annoying rubber feet that keep falling off. Not a big deal, though. Just a nuisance. Makes a great cat bed and tripping hazard when you're too lazy to put it away properly. Might eventually pick up the 17" model with the clamp, considering how sturdy this "simple" 18" model is. The cat might appreciate it.
